description: This file defines the 'Article' class within the Opencart admin model CMS namespace. It provides methods for managing articles, including CRUD operations, descriptions, SEO URLs, layouts, and ratings. The class interacts with the database and cache to store and retrieve article data, supporting multi-language and multi-store configurations.

classes.name: Article
classes.description: Represents the admin-side model for managing articles, including creation, editing, deletion, and retrieval, along with related descriptions, SEO URLs, layouts, and ratings.

methods.name: addArticle
methods.description: Inserts a new article into the database, handling descriptions, store associations, SEO URLs, layouts, and cache invalidation.

methods.name: editArticle
methods.description: Updates an existing article with new data, managing descriptions, store associations, SEO URLs, layouts, ratings, and cache.

methods.name: deleteArticle
methods.description: Deletes an article and all its related data including descriptions, store links, SEO URLs, layouts, comments, and cache.

methods.name: getArticle
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information for a specific article, including descriptions by language.

methods.name: getArticles
methods.description: Fetches a list of articles with optional filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalArticles
methods.description: Returns the total number of articles matching optional filters.

methods.name: addDescription
methods.description: Adds a new description entry for an article in a specific language.

methods.name: deleteDescriptions
methods.description: Removes all descriptions for a specified article.

methods.name: deleteDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes all description entries corresponding to a specific language ID.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Retrieves all descriptions associated with a particular article.

methods.name: getDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Returns descriptions filtered by a specific language ID.

methods.name: addStore
methods.description: Associates an article with a store.

methods.name: deleteStores
methods.description: Removes all store associations for an article.

methods.name: addLayout
methods.description: Assigns a layout to an article for a specific store.

methods.name: deleteLayouts
methods.description: Removes all layout associations from an article.

methods.name: editRating
methods.description: Updates the rating score for an article.

methods.name: addStore
methods.description: Associates an article with a store by inserting a record into the `article_to_store` table.

methods.name: deleteStores
methods.description: Removes all store associations for a given article from the `article_to_store` table.

methods.name: getStores
methods.description: Retrieves all store IDs associated with a specific article.

methods.name: addLayout
methods.description: Assigns a layout to an article for a specific store by inserting into `article_to_layout`.

methods.name: deleteLayouts
methods.description: Deletes all layout associations for a given article.

methods.name: deleteLayoutsByLayoutId
methods.description: Deletes all associations for a specific layout ID from the `article_to_layout` table.

methods.name: getLayouts
methods.description: Retrieves all layout IDs associated with a specific article, keyed by store ID.

methods.name: getTotalLayoutsByLayoutId
methods.description: Returns the total number of layout associations for a given layout ID.

methods.name: editCommentStatus
methods.description: Updates the 'status' field (e.g., approved or not) of a specific comment.

methods.name: editCommentRating
methods.description: Updates the rating of a specific comment.

methods.name: deleteComment
methods.description: Deletes a specific comment by its ID.

methods.name: deleteCommentsByArticleId
methods.description: Deletes all comments associated with a specific article.

methods.name: getComment
methods.description: Fetches detailed information of a comment by its ID.

methods.name: getRatings
methods.description: Retrieves rating counts, grouped by rating value, for an article and optionally a specific comment ID.

methods.name: getComments
methods.description: Retrieves a list of comments based on various filtering options, with pagination.

methods.name: getTotalComments
methods.description: Returns the total number of comments matching filter criteria.
